packageRules.description: Keep gitleaks in lockstep across scripts/install_pkgs.sh (github-releases) and .pre-commit-config.yaml (pre-commit manager).
Hold Pillow below 12 in the robocar simulation: genesis-world -> moviepy requires pillow<12, so a 12.x pin makes the dependency set unsatisfiable (#732). Drop once moviepy allows Pillow 12.

Only patch bumps for the actions/setup-python python-version input (github-actions manager, depType uses-with, depName python, packageName actions/python-versions). A new Python minor can lack wheels for torch and other deps, so moving to one is a deliberate change, not a Renovate PR (#796).
